title: Outstandingly Spicy Jamaican Herring Curry
description: A spicy and indulgent Jamaican dish featuring herring, this curry is paleo-friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner. The combination of fluffy rice and tender herring creates a delightful culinary experience.
instructions: Rinse the herring fillets and set them aside to drain excess water.
Heat the coconut oil in a large pressure cooker over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and saute until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the chopped scotch bonnet peppers and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the curry powder, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the herring fillets to the pressure cooker and stir to coat with the spice mixture.
Add 1 cup of water to the pressure cooker and bring to a boil.
Close the lid of the pressure cooker and cook for 10 minutes.
While the herring is cooking, prepare the cauliflower rice according to package instructions.
Once the herring is cooked, serve it over the cauliflower rice and enjoy.
